purpose: Starry furniture preview at AMOLED native display dimensions

prompts.name: bowl-starry-empty-v1
prompts.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: independent transparent STARRY NIGHT furniture sprite for StickMon, a tiny handheld creature-care game. Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET and defines object category, camera, orientation and approximate silhouette. Input image 2 is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY, the approved starry-night pet bed. Create a matching replacement of image 1. Match the bed's cozy detailed original handcrafted game art: warm dark walnut/honey-brown wood, muted indigo and slate-blue padding or ceramic, cream edges and a few flat golden stars/crescents. Crisp dark warm stepped outlines, compact readable color clusters, restrained broad shading, no photorealism or noisy microtexture. Not the coarse pixel trial style. The exact final game sprite dimensions are given below: design shapes to remain readable at that tiny size. One complete object, centered with transparent padding, no clipping. Preserve the target camera and orientation. True transparent alpha outside silhouette; no white/checkerboard backdrop, room, wall, floor, display platform, captions, text, labels, UI, watermark or characters. No external cast shadow. Self-shading is allowed.
Specific design: EMPTY low round pet bowl in muted indigo ceramic, broad cream elliptical rim and cream interior. One large flat golden crescent centered on the front, with at most two tiny broad star motifs at its sides, thin warm walnut accent foot. Remove ALL berries and ALL food; game draws food separately. Preserve elevated front view, round low bowl proportions. Final display is 40x28 pixels: the crescent must read clearly, no fine engravings, no attached protruding stars.
